seed: The user, 2026-11-15: recordings came out lighter and banded, and they want them low latency, light on the Mac and as lossless as possible. Recordings are now 10-bit HEVC in the screen's own colours at the encoder's top quality (Best): every gradient as smooth as a screenshot, at the same load, four times macOS's file size while the whole screen moves and smaller than it on a still screen. Smaller files is about half macOS's size with faint bands in dark gradients. At Next defaults with no flag touched, Settings has a Recording section with one row, Quality, reading Best.
